# Aviator Auto Analyzer — GitHub phone build

## Build the APK using only a phone

1. Create a new GitHub repository.
2. Upload the contents of this project so `settings.gradle*`, `app/`, and `.github/` are at the repository root.
3. Open **Actions**.
4. Select **Build Aviator APK**.
5. Tap **Run workflow**.
6. When the run finishes, open the run and download the **AviatorAuto-debug-apk** artifact.
7. Extract the ZIP and install the APK on Android.

## Important
The app analyzes detected round results; it cannot guarantee the next multiplier. Do not remove the app's Accessibility permission unless you want automatic reading to stop.
